integrity.claim_scope: Odd integers 9 through 10^9 except 21; sharp covering height on n congruent 3 modulo 18 starting at 39.
integrity.method: Exact divisor dynamic programming and Eratosthenes sieve
integrity.reproducibility: The complete executable finite checker is embedded as verify.cpp.

scientific_limitations: Exact finite result only through 10^9, no general odd-conjecture proof.
Computational exhaustiveness relies on reproducible source code and its correct execution.
Unindexed equivalent prior work is not excluded.
title: Sharp \(4288\) covering height for the Zumkeller--prime conjecture through \(10^9\)
